plugins.name: shopify-devkit
plugins.description: Scaffold Shopify Online Store 2.0 themes, generate Liquid sections, scaffold Shopify Functions and checkout extensions, and audit themes for performance and security.

skills.name: admin-api-query
skills.description: Generate an idiomatic Shopify Admin API GraphQL query or mutation with cursor pagination, fragments, and the correct permissions. Use when the user asks to query the Admin API, list products or orders, build a GraphQL query for Shopify, or write a mutation to update shop data.
headings: Generate a Shopify Admin API GraphQL query or mutation
Example: bulk query for large result sets
skills.description_zh: 生成符合惯用写法的 Shopify Admin API GraphQL 查询或 mutation，包含游标分页、片段及正确权限。适用于列出商品或订单、设计查询及更新店铺数据操作。

skills.name: checkout-ui-ext
skills.description: Scaffold a Shopify checkout UI extension with extension.toml and src/Checkout.jsx. Use when the user asks to create a checkout extension, add a banner or input to the checkout page, build an upsell widget for checkout, or scaffold a Shopify checkout UI extension.
skills.description_zh: 生成 Shopify 结账 UI 扩展骨架，包含 extension.toml 和 src/Checkout.jsx。适用于结账页横幅、输入框、加购组件或新扩展项目。

skills.name: liquid-section
skills.description: Generate a Liquid section for a Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme with a settings schema, blocks, and presets that appear in the theme editor. Use when the user asks to create a new section, add a hero or featured collection, build a custom section, or scaffold a Liquid section file.
headings: Schema rules the section must follow
Example: add the section to the home page JSON template
skills.description_zh: 为 Shopify Online Store 2.0 主题生成 Liquid section，包含可在主题编辑器中使用的设置 schema、blocks 和 presets。适用于主视觉、精选商品集合或自定义主题区块。

skills.name: shopify-function
skills.description: Scaffold a Shopify Function (product discount, cart transform, delivery customization, or payment customization) in Rust or JavaScript. Generates shopify.extension.toml, the input GraphQL query, and the run entry point. Use when the user asks to create a Shopify Function, a product discount function, a cart transform, a delivery customization, or a payment customization.
skills.description_zh: 以 Rust 或 JavaScript 生成 Shopify Function 骨架，支持商品折扣、购物车转换、配送或支付定制，输出 shopify.extension.toml、输入 GraphQL 查询和运行入口。

skills.name: theme-audit
skills.description: Audit a Shopify theme for render-blocking Liquid, missing asset_url filters, direct output of user data without escape, oversized image uploads, excessive section count, and missing accessibility attributes on forms. Use when the user asks to audit a theme, review a theme for performance or security, find Liquid issues, or check a theme before deploying.
headings: Check 3: direct output of user data without escape (XSS)
Check 5: excessive section count on a single template
Check 6: missing accessibility attributes on forms
skills.description_zh: 审查 Shopify 主题的阻塞渲染 Liquid、缺少 asset_url 过滤器、用户数据未转义输出、图片过大、section 过多及表单无障碍属性缺失。适用于性能、安全或部署前检查。

skills.name: theme-init
skills.description: Scaffold a Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme directory with the full folder layout (assets, config, layout, locales, sections, snippets, templates, blocks), a starter settings_schema.json, and a working layout/theme.liquid. Use when the user asks to start a new Shopify theme, create an OS 2.0 theme skeleton, or initialize a Shopify theme project.
headings: Scaffold a Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme
skills.description_zh: 初始化 Shopify Online Store 2.0 主题目录，提供 assets、config、layout、locales、sections、snippets、templates、blocks 完整结构、初始 settings_schema.json 和可运行的 layout/theme.liquid。

commands.name: dev
commands.description: Start the Shopify app dev server with automatic port-conflict recovery and a reminder about tunnel URLs. Runs `shopify app dev` and watches for common first-run failures (port in use, unlinked app, missing CLI).
headings: Start the Shopify app dev server

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check the local Shopify toolchain. Reports Shopify CLI version, Node version, npm version, and the current Rust WebAssembly target if Rust is installed. Use before scaffolding a function or running a theme audit to confirm the environment is ready.

commands.name: full-audit
commands.description: Run the full Shopify theme and app audit pass in one command. Chains doctor and theme-audit, plus checks app config if `shopify.app.toml` is present. Use before deploying a theme update or publishing an app version.
headings: Step 2: Detect what is in cwd
Step 4: App extension audit, if extensions present
